subject: Re: Kickoff: infinite-width uncertainty & calibration audit
body: Closing decision for this window. The calibration report went to Eleni's staff on Tuesday and the takeaway held up: NNGP plus ESS gives a defensible calibration reference, and the ECE gap vs finite-width is consistent across the Myrtle-10 grid. Decision: we are not standing up a live service this half. We ship the Colab notebooks as-is (ESS implementation plus kernel loaders), publish the internal report, and revisit the service question with the H2 GPC extension. Rationale: the mixing cost on large kernels makes on-demand runs too slow for a review-time tool; precomputing is the right shape, and that's an H2-sized job. Thanks all — clean landing, three days inside the window. Deshawn, keep the July staffing plan penciled in as discussed. — Ximena
